annual.convertibleTreatment: reported fair-value debt paired with capped-call asset; no conversion shares
annual.note: The $1,774m debt balance already reflects convertible fair value. Its $153m capped-call hedge is included in other assets. Additional claims are the $206m acquisition earnout and $405m vested deferred compensation. Conversion shares are not added again. Using debt principal instead would increase equity by $677m before dilution.
annual.noteZh: 17.74亿美元债务已反映可转债公允价值；1.53亿美元封顶看涨对冲计入其他资产。额外请求权为2.06亿美元收购业绩支付及4.05亿美元已归属递延薪酬。不会再次加入转换股数。改用债务本金会在稀释前增加6.77亿美元权益。

limitationsZh: 2026财年只包含CyberArk和Chronosphere的部分年度营收，但资产负债表已包含全部收购。增长假设计入首年收购全年化影响。
可转债及封顶看涨对冲采用配套的申报公允价值。改用本金会在稀释前增加6.77亿美元普通股权益；不可重复增加转换股数。
businessSummary: Network, cloud, security operations and identity security.
businessSummaryZh: 网络、云端、安全运营及身份安全。
rationale: 18% initial growth includes acquired-business annualization and then fades.23% mature GAAP margin requires integration and operating leverage; full acquisition goodwill means historical book ROIC is not a clean organic return.
rationaleZh: 初期18%增长包含收购业务全年化效应，随后放缓。成熟期23%GAAP利润率需要整合及经营杠杆；全部收购商誉令历史账面ROIC无法直接代表有机回报。
